title: Lightspeed targets $250M for new India fund, focusing on early-stage AI
description: The Silicon Valley firm is aligning its India fundraising cycle with its global funds for the first time, as it shifts to a shorter investment period.

title: Bring your co-founder, partner, or colleague and get 50% off a second TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass
description: Buy one pass to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 and get 50% off a second of the same ticket type. Register before event starts on October 13 at 8 a.m. PT.

title: PrismML brings its tiny LLMs to Qualcomm-powered smart glasses
description: Prism's larger goal is open-weight AI that runs on devices and makes better use of the computing power they already have.

title: Oracle sends force majeure notice on its New Mexico Stargate data center
description: The notice would allow Oracle to delay payments should the facility miss its 2028 target to come online.

title: Meta’s Muse Charm looks like a Tamagotchi, but it’s tapping into a much newer trend
description: Meta’s new AI gadget may look like a Tamagotchi, but its dangling form factor taps into a much broader Gen Z trend around bag charms, retro tech, and turning gadgets into fashion accessories.

title: Google Photos ‘Clueless’-inspired virtual closet is now available on Android and iOS
description: The AI-powered feature builds a virtual wardrobe from your photos, and is now broadly available after first rolling out to Android users in June.

title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026: Everything you need to know
description: TechCrunch Founder Summit is a full-day gathering in Boston on November 4 where founders across all stages connect with top VCs and experienced entrepreneurs to gain tactical insights on building and scaling their companies.

title: ElevenLabs’ CEO on margins, IPO timing, and telling customers they’re talking to a bot
description: ElevenLabs powers the AI voice on the other end of a lot of customer service calls, and its CEO told me this week that businesses should probably tell you that — at least until getting a machine is what everyone expects anyway.

title: Meet the next wave of VCs judging Startup Battlefield 200 at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
description: Meet the next wave of VCs judging the Startup Battlefield 200 contenders on the main stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Register by September 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT, to save up to $200 and to get a front-row seat to one of the most intense startup pitch competitions.

title: Google tests letting Gemini call businesses for you
description: Google says the AI-calling feature will first be available to Pixel 11 owners in the U.S. who pay for a Gemini subscription.

title: Shield AI, Waabi, and General Motors on building AI when failure is not an option at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
description: Leaders from Waabi, Shield AI, and General Motors join the Real World AI Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 to talk building AI. Save up to $200 by September 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT. Get a second pass at 50% off.

title: Lovable’s annualized revenue crosses $600M as vibe coding takes off
description: Lovable co-founder Fabian Hedin said that apps created on the platform are getting nearly a billion monthly views each month.

title: Ando wants to take on Slack with a team messaging app that lets humans and agents work together
description: The app gives agents their own identities and inboxes and lets them partake in conversations as naturally as people can.

title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Cal AI’s Zach Yadegari on how to create viral growth and capitalize on it
description: Zach Yadegari joins the Builders Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 to share how he capitalized on viral growth. Save up to $200 before September 25. Save 50% on a second pass.

title: 2 days left to save up to $200 on a TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass — reason 4 of 5 to attend
description: Reason 4 of 5 to attend TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Practical answers. Two days left to save up to $200 on your pass. Savings disappear after September 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT. Bring a second guest at 50% off.

title: Australia to investigate if OpenAI hack of government health website broke the law
description: The incident is the first known breach to affect a government agency, and Australia's prime minister has vowed to hold OpenAI accountable.

title: Everything new coming to Meta’s AI agent Muse
description: CEO Mark Zuckerberg kicked off the company’s annual Connect event in Menlo Park on Wednesday with a keynote that made one thing clear: Meta is going all-in on Muse. It's even coming to Meta's AI glasses.

title: Meta made a Tamagotchi-like wearable for its Muse AI agent
description: The tiny hardware device creates another mobile home for its AI agent Muse.

title: Meta introduces camera-free AI glasses
description: Meta says the camera-free glasses will be lighter and have up to 12 hours of battery life.

title: Anthropic says its biology lab has already found something big
description: But maybe the biggest reveal is that Anthropic has not let Claude run loose in its biology lab. Humans are still, so far, in the loop.
